page.layout: One page of text in a single column. No marginal notes. Below the text: the signature "Mm 4" at the left and the catchword "tus," at the right.

main_text.p: Angliæ regno magis innotescant, ut detracta mendaciorum larva, nuda rerum nostrarum veritate detecta, firmiorem ipsi pacem & solidioribus nixam fundamentis, cum religionis & legum nostrarum libertate impetremus. Turbarum architectos eos quidem qui e nobis egressi sunt, remitti volumus, ut ex legibus patriis causa ipsorum cognoscatur, & sententia feratur: At perniciosos consultores Anglos, omnium utriusque regni aerumnarum fontes & capita, ad ejus gentis Comitiorum tribunal remittemus, eorumque supplicium ordinum regni arbitrio permittemus.

Quum reformationis hujus progressus ab ultimis usque primordiis, reflexa mentis acie speculamur, & divinæ providentiæ admirando omnia consilio moderantis vestigia observamus, in mediis quantumvis angustiis, paternam Dei erga Ecclesiam patriamque nostram curam & gratiam non possumus non celebrare, & animosioris deinceps ac bonæ spei pleni ejus ductum & auspicia sequi perseverare.

Quum jam immensis opibus, ampliffimis honoribus, eminente in omnes omnium conditionum cives, Euangelii ministros juxta & cæteros, potestate, eximia dignitatis Parliamentariæ, Senatoriæ Prætoriæ, Scaccariæ, & in celsa Commissione Delegatoriæ authoritate ad summum dominatus fastigium Prælati ascendissent, & altero pede Ecclesiam, altero Rempublicam complexi, ad intolerandam arrogantiam assurrexissent, in ipso extremitatis articulo (quod Domino tempus opportunum esse solet) opus hoc inchoari cœptum est: initiis quidem tenuibus, & nihil eximium ominantibus: sed majora tamen quotidie, divino consilio, per singula vestigia necessitate quadam ineluctabili premente, pedetentim est progressum.

page.notes: Running head and page number taken from the top line. The catchword "tus," and signature "Mm 4" are at the foot. A faint mark at bottom centre is not printed text and is omitted. Ligature forms (ss, si, ct, tt) were normalised to plain letters; the "s" long s was written as s throughout. Possible misreadings in the scan: "Prætoriæ" and "Delegatoriæ" are read from a small, low-contrast print and should be checked.
